title: Mortgage Overpay Myth Busted

scenes.text: Adding $200 each month to a 30‑year mortgage sounds like a fast wealth hack.
Paying extra on your mortgage is the fastest way to build wealth.
scenes.label: Extra mortgage payments grow wealth

scenes.text: Investing that $200 in a diversified index fund historically yields higher returns than the interest saved on the loan.
scenes.label: Investing beats mortgage paydown
scenes.query: index fund returns vs mortgage interest

scenes.text: Put extra cash into the market, not the loan.
scenes.label: Invest, Don't Overpay

scenes.text: Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.

description: Many think extra mortgage payments fast‑track wealth. The reality? Investing the same money often outperforms loan paydown. Learn the smarter move today.
